meta.title: Dated decision checkpoints
meta.source: content/tracking.md section 6.5 (dated checkpoints) and 7.5, plan/strategy.md sections 6 and 17, data/calendar.json actions. Collected for the war-room 'next decision due' card; edit freely.
meta.note: Dates marked approx are planning guesses from the plan, not commitments. Decisions are owner decisions [O] unless stated.

checkpoints.title: Pre-launch: countdown, teasers and DM keywords
checkpoints.detail: Countdown live on makeborne.com to Thu 29 Oct 21:00 CET; nothing says Wed 28 Oct or 19:00 any more; teasers never say it is live; DM keywords answer from a second account; Wednesday and Thursday scheduled.
checkpoints.source: Owner decision 27 Oct 2026: launch Thu 29 Oct 21:00 CET

checkpoints.title: Launch-day owner calls (21:00 CET launch)
checkpoints.detail: Set the AI daily limit for launch day, confirm support cover with a 4 h reply target, approve operating costs outside the $1,000 (demo builds, comped creator credits).

checkpoints.title: Attribution live (spend gate)
checkpoints.detail: /go/ links, first-touch storage and mb_src / mb_campaign / mb_aff on Makeborne-created checkouts. If not live: ship the 'How did you hear about us?' fallback; creator payments and boosts wait. Stays Thu 29 Oct (launch day 2) after the launch moved.

checkpoints.title: First weekly review (day 7) + images go/no-go
checkpoints.detail: First 90-minute weekly review, on day 7 (Tue 3 Nov). Check generated images against the six-box gate before any beat is scheduled.

checkpoints.title: Boost precondition (D4 not yet)
checkpoints.detail: Week 3 starts. D4 may start once a source has 3+ net payers at <= $50 CAC (earliest about 23 Nov), so no reinvestment today. Confirm both ad accounts can be registered and billed before boost slot A.

checkpoints.title: Boost slot A decision + images gate check
checkpoints.detail: Qualify posts at 48 h (3x median views, 65%+ 3-second hold, 1+ tracked sale or 5+ link clicks per 1,000 views). Six-box gate for images before Launch Week 1.

checkpoints.title: Offer check (organic conversion)
checkpoints.detail: The creator test cannot be read yet (wave-1 first videos 9-15 Nov; keep rule counts 14 days after video 2). Judge organic /go/ visit-to-paid only (D2 trigger: under 0.7%) plus boost slot A.

checkpoints.title: Re-forecast gate
checkpoints.detail: Cumulative gross paid: under 100 = plan on low-to-base; 100-200 = base; 200+ = high or breakout path (calculator breakout ~200, high ~230 by day 28), raise reinvestment and AI capacity.

checkpoints.title: Earliest D4 reinvestment Monday
checkpoints.detail: D4 starts only when a source has 3+ net payers at <= $50 CAC: 30% of last week's net new cash into sources at or under target CAC.

checkpoints.title: Day-30 public numbers post
checkpoints.detail: Publish redacted real numbers (if the owner approves D11). 25 Nov is day 28 since the 29 Oct launch: the post says "Day 28" or "4 weeks in", never "Day 30". Black Friday message is only 'yearly is 20% off' (D5) from 27 Nov.

checkpoints.title: Paid-CAC offer check + wave-2 creators
checkpoints.detail: Before any money beyond wave 1: if no source has net payers at <= $50 CAC, change the offer (D1/D2) before buying more views. If images are not live by 30 Nov, the $140 wave-2 line rehires the best wave-1 creator instead.

checkpoints.title: Consent banner and server-side purchase events
checkpoints.detail: Prerequisite for any Meta, TikTok or Google pixel, retargeting or Conversions API upload. Legal view on /go/ and referral codes first.

checkpoints.title: Content Rewards gate (revenue only)
checkpoints.detail: A source at <= $50 CAC on 3+ payers AND MRR above about $1.5k? If yes, open Content Rewards from revenue at a $1.60 per 1,000 views plan.

checkpoints.title: Breakout check
checkpoints.detail: About 750 cumulative gross payers needed to stay on the $1M ARR path (calculator breakout). If not, drop the $1M expectation in writing and optimise for base.

checkpoints.title: Day 57 (24 Dec): reserve and loops check
checkpoints.detail: Unspent reserve (b9) moves to the best source by CAC; loop share exit gate 15%.

checkpoints.title: Extra accounts check
checkpoints.detail: Add a faceless outputs account or niche TikTok only with editing help in place and a format with 3+ wins.

checkpoints.title: Day-90 report and review
checkpoints.detail: Which surfaces to keep; free-tier and preview decision for next quarter.
